counts_are: plain_contra = (group, lot car) donor pairs shown plain whose own decode contradicts the class

classes.engine: the engine column leaves out a displacement the catalog attests for T (raw, over-broad: a row's engines span its years); engine_material: and T's year page or a lot car of T has it
classes.fuel: a gas gate without an engine gate where a hybrid-only displacement exists (catalog hybrid words, or lot cars the app reads as hybrid); plain cars decoded with it
classes.market: km/h / export / foreign-market words anywhere in the class's record or own-page notes (text hits; most are US alternatives, see details)
classes.cab: every config names a cab and T's page lists a left-out cab under another number, no cab gate
classes.body: the same for silhouette words in the fitment trims, no body gate
classes.joined: a joined drive token (2WDSTD, 2WDHICAS) with no drive gate
